label: RV-EV-01
command_argv:
PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<"PY"
import importlib.util
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from agentic_payment_experiment import Decision, PaymentStatus
from agentic_payment_experiment.trusted_execution import KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rv_known", Path("tests/trusted_execution/test_known_payment_attempt.py"))
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
fact_case=mod.KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightTests(methodName="test_empty_inventory_is_clear_and_primitive_serializable"); fact_case.setUp()

unrelated=replace(fact_case.succeeded,request_id="request-other",payment_id="",status="INVALID_STATUS",transaction_object_ref=None,authority_ref=None,agent_ref=None,payee=None)
with patch("agentic_payment_experiment.trusted_execution.known_payment_attempt.verify_payment_execution_binding") as verifier:
    clear=fact_case.derive((unrelated,))
    verifier.assert_not_called()
assert clear.status is KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus.CLEAR
assert clear.related_attempt_refs == () and clear.blocking_request_refs == ()

for rid in (None,"","   ",123):
    unknown=replace(fact_case.succeeded,request_id=rid)
    result=fact_case.derive((unknown,))
    assert result.status is KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus.INDETERMINATE
    assert result.reason_codes == ("known_payment_attempt_request_ref_missing",)

same_bad=replace(fact_case.succeeded,payment_id="")
assert fact_case.derive((same_bad,)).status is KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus.INDETERMINATE
assert fact_case.derive((fact_case.succeeded,)).status is KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus.BLOCKED
forward=fact_case.derive((unrelated,fact_case.succeeded)).to_dict()
reverse=fact_case.derive((fact_case.succeeded,unrelated)).to_dict()
assert forward == reverse and forward["status"] == "BLOCKED"

spec2=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rv_gate", Path("tests/test_webshop_runtime_gate.py"))
mod2=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2); spec2.loader.exec_module(mod2)
gate_case=mod2.WebShopRuntimeGateTest(methodName="test_empty_known_attempt_input_preserves_prior_gate_result"); gate_case.setUp()
gate_unrelated=replace(gate_case.execution,request_id="request-other",payment_id="",status="INVALID_STATUS",transaction_object_ref=None,authority_ref=None,agent_ref=None,payee=None)
outcome,calls=gate_case.invoke(governed_action=gate_case.governed_action,known_payment_attempts=(gate_unrelated,))
assert outcome.decision is Decision.ALLOW and calls == ["checkout"] and outcome.callback_count == 1
assert outcome.known_payment_attempt_preflight_fact.status is KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus.CLEAR
same_gate_bad=replace(gate_case.execution,payment_id="",status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
outcome_bad,calls_bad=gate_case.invoke(governed_action=gate_case.governed_action,known_payment_attempts=(same_gate_bad,))
assert outcome_bad.decision is Decision.INDETERMINATE and calls_bad == [] and outcome_bad.callback_count == 0
same_gate_valid=replace(gate_case.execution,payment_id="existing-success",status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
outcome_dup,calls_dup=gate_case.invoke(governed_action=gate_case.governed_action,known_payment_attempts=(same_gate_valid,))
assert outcome_dup.decision is Decision.DENY and calls_dup == [] and outcome_dup.callback_count == 0
print({"fact_unrelated":clear.to_dict(),"fact_unknown":"INDETERMINATE","fact_same_malformed":"INDETERMINATE","fact_same_succeeded":"BLOCKED","gate_unrelated":{"decision":outcome.decision.value,"callback":outcome.callback_count},"gate_same_malformed":{"decision":outcome_bad.decision.value,"callback":outcome_bad.callback_count},"gate_same_succeeded":{"decision":outcome_dup.decision.value,"callback":outcome_dup.callback_count},"order_independent":forward==reverse})
PY
